cards.ex: He was in a blind rage and started smashing things.
cards.exUz: U ko'r g'azabda edi va narsalarni sindira boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli, aqlsiz g'azab holati, o'zini nazorat qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: My boss will be livid when he finds out about this mistake.
cards.exUz: Boshlig'im bu xatoni bilgach, juda jahli chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq g'azablanmoq, qattiq achchiqlanmoq.

cards.ex: That horror movie scared the living daylights out of me.
cards.exUz: O'sha qo'rqinchli film meni o'ldiradigan darajada qo'rqitdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli qo'rqitmoq, dahshatga solmoq.

cards.ex: She was beside herself with worry when her son didn't come home.
cards.exUz: O'g'li uyga kelmaganida, u tashvishdan o'zini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli his-tuyg'ular tufayli o'zini nazorat qila olmaslik (g'azab, qo'rquv va h.k.).

cards.ex: The new employee was shaking in his boots before the presentation.
cards.exUz: Yangi xodim taqdimotdan oldin etikda titrayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqmoq, vahimaga tushmoq.

cards.ex: He was seething with anger after the unfair decision.
cards.exUz: Adolatsiz qarordan so'ng u g'azabdan qaynab turardi.
cards.uzDef: Ichki g'azabni tashqi ko'rinishga chiqarmay, juda g'azablanmoq.

cards.ex: After the accident, she was in a state of shock and couldn't speak.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan so'ng, u shok holatida edi va gapira olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir kutilmagan hodisa tufayli hayratda qolish va nima qilishni bilmaslik.

cards.ex: My parents will have a fit if they find out I wrecked the car.
cards.exUz: Agar men mashinani buzganimni bilishsa, ota-onam jahllaridan yorilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanmoq, qattiq jahli chiqmoq.

cards.ex: I had an uneasy feeling about the trip, like something bad was going to happen.
cards.exUz: Men sayohat haqida xavotirli his qildim, go'yo yomon narsa sodir bo'ladigandek.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon bo'lishi mumkinligini his qilish, noqulay sezgi.

cards.ex: We were on tenterhooks waiting for the exam results.
cards.exUz: Imtihon natijalarini xavotir bilan kutdik.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishini xavotir bilan kutish, sabrsizlik bilan kutish.

cards.ex: He went ballistic when he saw the damage to his car.
cards.exUz: Mashinasiga yetkazilgan zararni ko'rgach, u aqldan ozdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanmoq, aqlsizlarcha g'azablanmoq.

cards.ex: She was frozen with fear when she saw the snake.
cards.exUz: Ilonni ko'rgach, u qo'rquvdan muzlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqib, harakat qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: We stared in utter disbelief at the news report.
cards.exUz: Biz yangiliklar hisobotiga mutlaq ishonchsizlik bilan qaradik.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lganiga ishonmaslik, hayratda qolish.

cards.ex: He goes to the gym to blow off steam after a stressful day at work.
cards.exUz: U ishda stressli kundan so'ng g'azabini chiqarish uchun sport zaliga boradi.
cards.uzDef: G'azab yoki stressni qandaydir yo'l bilan chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: My heart was pounding as I walked onto the stage.
cards.exUz: Sahna tomon yurganimda yuragim urishi kuchaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquv, hayajon yoki g'azabdan yurak tez urishi.

cards.ex: I was sick with worry while waiting for the doctor's call.
cards.exUz: Shifokorning qo'ng'irog'ini kutayotganda tashvishdan kasal bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Juda tashvishlanib, o'zini yomon his qilish.

cards.ex: I got such a fright when the cat jumped out from behind the sofa.
cards.exUz: Mushuk divanning orqasidan sakrab chiqqanida juda qo'rqib ketdim.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rqinchli yoki kutilmagan narsadan qo'rqib ketmoq.

cards.ex: I'm at my wit's end trying to fix this computer.
cards.exUz: Men bu kompyuterni tuzatishga harakat qilib boshi qotdim.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni qanday hal qilishni bilmaslik, chalkashib ketish.

cards.ex: I saw red when he insulted my family.
cards.exUz: U mening oilamni haqorat qilganida, ko'zim qizardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanmoq, jahl otiga minmoq.

cards.ex: Ever since the robbery, she jumps at shadows.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlikdan beri u soyadan qo'rqadi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan qo'rqmoq, har narsadan xavotirlanmoq.

cards.ex: A surge of panic washed over me when I realized I'd lost my passport.
cards.exUz: Pasportimni yo'qotganimni anglaganimda, meni vahima to'lqini qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga kuchli vahima hissi.

cards.ex: Her kindness was beyond words.
cards.exUz: Uning mehribonligi so'z bilan aytib bo'lmas edi.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ularni so'z bilan ifodalash qiyin (hayrat, g'azab va h.k.).

cards.ex: I breathed a sigh of relief when I heard my son was safe.
cards.exUz: O'g'limning xavfsizligini eshitganimda yengil nafas oldim.
cards.uzDef: Xavotir yo'qolganda yengil nafas olmoq.

cards.ex: He flew into a rage when he found out about the betrayal.
cards.exUz: U xiyonatni bilib, g'azabga keldi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga juda g'azablanmoq.

cards.ex: She was petrified with fear during the earthquake.
cards.exUz: U zilzila paytida qo'rquvdan tosh qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqib, harakat qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: I was dumbfounded by the news.
cards.exUz: Men bu xabardan lol qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Hayratdan gapira olmay qolmoq.

cards.ex: I go for a run to let off steam.
cards.exUz: Men g'azabdan bo'shash uchun yuguraman.
cards.uzDef: G'azab, stress yoki boshqa kuchli hissiyotlarni qandaydir yo'l bilan yengillashtirmoq.

cards.ex: She was in the grip of fear as she walked through the dark forest.
cards.exUz: Qorong'u o'rmondan o'tayotganda uni qo'rquv changali qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli qo'rquv hissi bilan qamrab olingan.

cards.ex: He took the news of his failure really hard.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatsizlik xabarini juda og'ir qabul qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon xabarni yoki voqeani juda jiddiy va qayg'uli qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: My heart skipped a beat when he suddenly appeared.
cards.exUz: U to'satdan paydo bo'lganida, yuragim to'xtab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquv, hayrat yoki hayajondan yurakning urishi sezilmay qolishi.
